sources.entry: Metabase - Easy way for everyone in your company to ask questions and learn from data. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Java/Docker

summary.one_liner: Metabase is an open-source business intelligence and analytics platform that lets people in a company ask questions of their data and build dashboards, with or without SQL.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Metabase as a way for everyone in a company to ask questions and learn from data. Non-SQL users can ask questions through a query builder, and a SQL editor is available for more complex queries. Users can build interactive dashboards with filters, auto-refresh and fullscreen, and set alerts or schedule dashboard subscriptions to email, Slack, or a webhook. It also lists documents for long-form analysis, a Data Studio for transforming tables and defining metrics, and an embedding option with components for charts, dashboards and AI chat. An API is available for integrating analytics. The README mentions "Officially supported databases" and "Community drivers" without naming them in the text provided.
use_cases: letting non-technical staff query company data
scheduling dashboard emails or Slack reports
embedding charts and dashboards in a customer-facing app
writing and sharing SQL queries against a database
defining canonical metrics for a data team
how_to_run: Sign up for a free trial of Metabase Cloud (hosted option)
See the Installation Guides in the Metabase documentation to self-host; the README says Metabase 'can be run just about anywhere'
notable: Non-SQL query builder for everyday users plus a full SQL editor
Embedding SDK with charts, dashboards, data browser and AI chat components
Scheduled subscriptions and alerts to email, Slack or webhooks
Built-in Metabot AI assistant and option to build custom AI agents
Git versioning of work and a Library for curated content
caveats: Repository includes both open-source (AGPL) and commercial editions under a separate Metabase Commercial Software License
Cloud offering is the README's recommended easiest path; self-hosting requires setup
Some features such as AI and Data Studio are described without detail on which edition includes them
summary.license: AGPL-3.0 (open-source edition); commercial editions under Metabase Commercial Software License
